entry.value: Component to process Mascot exports (csv format) and to output single table concatenating the rows from all input files. The component has been tested and is compatible with the Mascot version 2.6.2 version exports in the csv format.%%00010%%00010The following filters are applied in the given order%%00010- peptide spectrum matches with rank >1 are removed%%00010- E-value (pep_expect column) needs to be equal or smaller than the provided E-value threshold%%00010- the duplicated rows are removed using the spectrum ID column (pep_query)%%00010%%00010Ion mobility infomration is extracted from the pep_scan_title column - extracts number after the "1/K0=" part of the scan title. In case the ion mobility extraction fails, no extra column is extracted.%%00010%%00010=================%%00010%%00010Used programs and tools and their respective licenses at the time of the metanode creation.
